endpoint.selection: Exact explicit Config.EndpointOverrides (cloud_1c,v2,scope), selected after discovery; no guessed regional host; base includes /v2
endpoint.ref_validation: For caller-provided refs, exact ID/URL binding match before credential lookup and HTTP; no redirect or selecting a ref-supplied endpoint

request.reference: Exact child ref with required caller cluster parent; full scope/generation/endpoint/ancestor validation before I/O; no implicit DNS operations

response.mapping: Typed DeleteClusterDomainResponse contains only optional parent cluster metadata; parent ACTIVE is not deletion evidence; exact child ref retained in accepted receipt on all errors
response.number_protection: Source JSON numbers are lexically validated and stored in onec.ProtectedNumber without precision conversion; formatting/JSON/Text redacts, Reveal is explicit

errors.mapping: Core bounded read status mapping; provider message excluded; malformed JSON ProtocolError
errors.lost_response: unknown_outcome with one attempt; no inferred ID, no list/name adoption

retry: no mutation replay on any unknown response

wait.status: Native list pages matched only by exact acknowledged ID; stop immediately when observed, no name/position/new-resource lookup
wait.budget: One CallTimeout across status page scan, bounded native iterator limits, outer WaitTimeout/context retained
wait.source_states: Only exact child CLUSTER_DOMAIN_STATUS_DELETED succeeds; ERRORED fails; documented other states pending; unconfirmed/missing list item never proves absence
wait.absence: Unconfirmed terminal cursor and missing item never prove absence; incomplete returned instead of deletion success
wait.limits: No DNS/TLS handshake or application readiness claim

recovery.kind: Exact newly acknowledged domain ID with explicit caller parent, no inference from DNS/name/list differences; parent-only unknown cannot recover child
